# Introduction

The books that I have chosen for my lab are The Art of Invisiblity by Kevin Mitnick, Sandworm by Andy Greenberg and The Web Application Hackers Handbook by Dafydd Stuttuard and Marcus Pinto. I chose these books by asking a friend for some books they've read recently all related to the same topic. These books are all related to cybersecurity. I will record the title, authors, publication year, genre, and ISBN for each book. I will create my HTML file and JSON file on Visual Studios and then import the data using R. I do not anticipate having too much trouble with this code because I completed a Full Stack Web Development bootcamp last spring so I have worked with both HTML and JSON files. However to import each into R I plan to use the readHTML() method from the RVest package and the fromJSON() method from the Jsonlite package to read the data into my R Markdown file and then I will compare the data after any potential reformatting that may be required.

```{r installing-necessary-packages}
library(jsonlite)
library(rvest)
```
